info.title: IncidentPilot API
info.description: Evidence-driven incident-response control plane HTTP surface. Session identity: Bearer stub tokens (see docs/auth.md); client-supplied actor_id is rejected. GroundTruth requires eval entitlement (C3), separate from ops RBAC. Alertmanager webhooks: /webhooks/alerts/alertmanager (F1–F5). Slack interactions: /webhooks/slack/interactions (K2/K3 HMAC); slash commands: /webhooks/slack/commands (K6).

post.description:
I6 eval/test harness — real ApprovalDecision + workflow signal.

Requires ``eval_entitled`` (ops Responder alone is not enough). Uses the
domain decide command (same rows as human decide) and signals
``approval_decision`` so ``wait_for_approval`` resumes.

Accept an Alertmanager webhook payload.

Auth: Bearer / Basic / custom header (see docs/alert-webhooks.md).
Replay: ``Idempotency-Key`` or ``X-Request-Id``, else SHA-256 of body.
Duplicate keys return **200** with ``status=duplicate`` (success/no-op).
F2/F4: normalize, upsert alert, correlate by fingerprint/time/service.
F5: after commit, idempotently start IncidentWorkflow → INVESTIGATING.

Verify Slack signature, persist interaction, map approve/reject (K3).

Invalid signatures never reach persistence (401). Valid payloads are written
to ``domain.slack_interaction`` **before** the 200 response. Stale action
versions return a visible ``STALE_ACTION_VERSION`` message (still HTTP 200
so Slack shows the ephemeral text).

Handle `/ip` slash commands (K6). BEST_EFFORT — never blocks remediation.

Form body (Slack): ``command``, ``text``, ``user_id``, …
